title: SB 2064 (112th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 2 and Title 49, relative to the Tennessee Student Voter Act.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) Sec.3, amends TCA 2-7-112(c)(2)
(quote) (2) A valid identification card that contains a photograph of the voter, and that was issued by this state, or by the United States where authorized by law to issue personal identification;
(section) Sec.4, adds 2-7-112(c)(8)
(quote) (8) A valid identification card that contains a photograph of the voter, and that was issued by an accredited postsecondary institution of education in this state.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule)
(section) Sec.5, amends TCA 2-2-115(b)(7)
(quote) (7) A person who registers by mail or online may vote in person or absentee by mail.
(other) Sec.1: short title 'Tennessee Student Voter Act'.
(other) Sec.2: each high school must tell each senior who reaches 18 that the student is eligible to vote and how to register (adds to 2-2-111); the SA0798 rewrite softens this to 'may be eligible'.
(other) Sec.5 (Draft only): replaces 2-2-115(b)(7) so a mail or online registrant may vote in person or absentee by mail.
(other) Sec.6: effective on becoming law.
(other) version: Draft 2494081: carries slots a (Sec.3-4) and e (Sec.5), plus the student voter act and high school notice.
(other) version: SA0798 (Senate State and Local Government amendment 1, 'delete all language after the enacting clause'): full rewrite with NO ID or citizenship text; keeps only the short title and a softened high-school notice (Sec.2). Skeleton marks it adopted=0, but the committee motion says 'with amendment/s'.
(other) note: Only floor/committee event: Senate State and Local Government committee 2022-03-23, 8-0, recommended with amendment; 2022-04-11 re-referred to Senate Calendar Committee. Whether SA0798 was adopted is not confirmed by the data flag (adopted=0), but it is the only amendment saved and the motion says 'with amendment/s'. If SA0798 was NOT adopted, the voted text is the Draft and carries slot a.

votes.motion: Senate committee: recommended for passage with amendment, 8-0 [version voted: Draft 2494081 + SA0798 (full rewrite) -- adoption of SA0798 inferred from 'with amendment/s' (data flag adopted=0)]
